widgets.title: First launches, by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage installAge=first name=app_opened platform=windows | timechart count by version

widgets.title: Seconds listened (app)
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name IN (read_paused, read_stopped) seconds>=0 platform=windows | timechart sum(seconds) as seconds

widgets.title: First-launch funnel (sessions), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage installAge=first platform=windows | stats count(eval(name="intro_ended")) as onb, count(eval(name="book_opened")) as bo, count(eval(name="read_started")) as rs, count(eval(name="book_listened")) as l30 by session, version | eval onboarded=if(onb>0,1,0), book_opened=if(bo>0,1,0), read_started=if(rs>0,1,0), listened_30s=if(l30>0,1,0) | stats count as sessions, sum(onboarded) as onboarded, sum(book_opened) as book_opened, sum(read_started) as read_started, sum(listened_30s) as listened_30s by version

widgets.title: Where first sessions stopped (last screen and event)
widgets.query: index=dino_usage installAge=first platform=windows | eventstats max(seq) as lastseq by session | where seq == lastseq | stats count by screen, name

widgets.title: Fallbacks, by reason
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=fallback platform=windows | timechart count by detail

widgets.title: Event flow (step to step)
widgets.query: index=dino_spans platform=windows | spantree | stats count by parent.name, span.name | sort -count

widgets.title: Where sessions end
widgets.query: index=dino_spans platform=windows | spantree | where child_count=0 | stats count by span.name | sort -count

widgets.title: App launches, by app version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | timechart count by version

widgets.title: App launches per version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over version by platform

widgets.title: First launches per version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage installAge=first name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over version by platform

widgets.title: OS version (launches), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over os by version

widgets.title: Phone, tablet or desktop (launches), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over form by version

widgets.title: CPU architecture (launches), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over arch by version

widgets.title: RAM in GB (launches), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over ram by version

widgets.title: CPU cores (launches), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over cores by version

widgets.title: App language (launches), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over uiLang by version

widgets.title: Country (launches), by version
widgets.query: index=dino_usage name=app_opened platform=windows | chart count over country by version
